description: Find official HUD active multifamily FHA mortgages maturing in an exact window, with optional state, holder-name, unpaid-balance, and HUD TC/LIHTC filters. Returns property, project number, maturity, balance, units, lender, rate, and source provenance from HUD's monthly FHA Subsidiary Ledger extract. Use this for 'FHA loans maturing in Texas next year' or 'multifamily debt maturity schedule'. A maturity is a filed source field, not refinance intent or a contact lead list.

response_format.description: Human-readable markdown or machine-readable JSON. Default markdown.

name: hud_fha_maturity_search
